title: NNTP GROUP with invalid name: sends 211 but sets current_group=None
description: reader/session/dispatch.rs:83-91: GroupName::new(name).ok() silently returns None on parse failure, but the handler still returns a 211 response (group selected). ctx.current_group is None while the client believes it has a valid group selected. Subsequent commands checking group_selected() may proceed on a None group. Trigger: GROUP invalid..name (double-dot). Expected: 411 response. Fix: return 411 immediately if GroupName::new fails.
